label: early input of a/w/g/b/n (pos 2-5) in sequences starting with 1/h/3/d/2/x/r
explanation: Fires only during the original-input phase, at positions 2-6 (peak at t=3-4; never at t=0-1, the delimiter, or the copy phase). Driven mainly by the current input being one of a, w, g, b, n (about 80% of mass), almost always on its first occurrence. Magnitude is modulated by sequence context: largest when the first original token is 1 (top examples all start 1 ... then w/a/g), and also elevated for first token h, 3, d, 2. Gating by input token and position alone gives about 70% recall at 15% precision. Adding the first-token condition gives F1 about 0.45. The rest depends on finer prefix composition that no simple predicate captures. Some weak activations occur on other letters (j, v, o, e).

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=2: w, a, g, n; t=3: a, w, g, b; t=4: a, w, g, n) and the first original token (most: 1, 3, h, d, 2, x; least: n, a, g, w); timing cues that raise it most: t=3, t=4, t=5.
